description: The pie chart presents the category distribution of a dataset, showing how the total is divided across 6 labeled categories. The slices are color-coded and annotated with percentage labels placed outside the wedges: “chat” is shown in a light pink/salmon color at approximately 41.2%, “math” in blue at about 21.9%, “tooluse” in light green at about 11.6%, “multi turn chat” in light orange/peach at about 9.3%, “code” in a light lavender/purple at about 9.0%, and “instruction follow” in a light pink/magenta tone at about 6.9%. A legend titled “Categories” appears in the upper-left and lists each category with a matching color swatch and a count in parentheses (e.g., chat (546,526), math (290,496), tooluse (154,358), multi turn chat (123,615), code (119,563), instruction follow (91,460)). No slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized, and the wedges appear arranged roughly in descending order of percentage from largest to smallest.
